results.quantity: is span(A.6) isometric to U(2)^3 (the pullback lattice)? parity-of-norm/2 test

So TT's (A.6) integral basis is NOT U(2)^3; we make no claim on which is geometrically correct, only that the two differ as Z-lattices (tier B).
